## Stone Troglodyte (CR 2)

**XP** 600  
 CE Medium  monstrous humanoid (earth, reptillian)  
 **Init** -1; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +7  

**Defense**

 **AC** 17, touch 9, flat-footed 17 (-1 Dex, +8 natural)  
 **hp** 39 (3d10+9)  
 **Fort** +6, **Ref** +2, **Will** +4  
 **Immune** poison  
 **Weaknesses** light sensitivity  

**Offense**

 **Speed** 20 ft. burrow 20 ft.  
 **Melee** bite +5 (1d6+1), 2 claws +4 (1d4+1)  
 **Special Attacks** rock spew (20-ft. cone, DC 14, 2d6 slashing)  
 **Spell-Like Abilities** (CL 5th; concentration +5)  

  1/day—stone shape  

**Statistics**

 **Str** 12, **Dex** 9, **Con** 16, **Int** 9, **Wis** 12, **Cha** 10  
 **Base Atk** +3; **CMB** +4; **CMD** 13  
 **Feats** Great Fortitude, Weapon Focus (bite)  
 **Skills** Climb +6, Perception +6, Stealth +4 (+8 in rocky areas); **Racial Modifier** +4 to Stealth in rocky areas  
 **Languages** Undercommon  

**Special Abilities**

 **Rock Spew (Ex)** Three times per day a stone troglodyte can spit a burst of sharp, rocky splinters in a 20-foot cone. Creatures caught in the area take 2d6 points of slashing damage, or half damage on a DC 14 Reflex save. The save DC is Constitution-based.

  
  

**Ecology**

 **Environment** underground  
 **Organization** solitary, pair, clutch (3-6), band (7-12 plus 1 druid of 3rd level and 1-2 monitor lizards), or tribe (20-80 plus 20% non-combatants, 1 chieftain druid of 3rd-6th level, 1-3 druids of 3rd- 6th level and 3-13 monitor lizards)  
 **Treasure** standard
